answer: An agent market for ferrous ore, voyage bookings, and violet dye can allocate transaction quotas in proportion to tokens locked in escrow for 30 days. Each identity's quota equals its share of the total locked stake, so splitting one deposit among a thousand fake agents yields no extra capacity. To control 10% of capacity, an attacker must fund 10% of all locked stake and bear the cost of tying up that capital for the full lock period.
